headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 14, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals secured a 9-6 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Iván Herrera leading the charge at the plate. Herrera's impressive performance included two home runs and three RBIs in just three at-bats. The New York Yankees also secured a win, taking down the Toronto Blue Jays 3-1 behind Paul Goldschmidt's 9th home run of the season. The San Diego Padres had a successful day, taking down the Baltimore Orioles twice, first 9-3 and then 5-2.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Michael Helman (Texas Rangers), who was placed on the 10-day injured list with an unspecified issue. Other players on the injured list include Keaton Winn (San Francisco Giants), Freddy Fermin (San Diego Padres), José Ramírez (Cleveland Guardians), Vinnie Pasquantino (Kansas City Royals), Evan Carter (Texas Rangers), Wilber Dotel (Pittsburgh Pirates), and Jack Flaherty (Detroit Tigers).

The Chicago White Sox made a notable trade, acquiring RF Nolan Jones and cash from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for Future Considerations. The White Sox also traded RF Derek Hill and Other Considerations to the Philadelphia Phillies for CF Dylan Campbell and 2B Jose Colmenares. The Detroit Tigers acquired RHP Jacob Waguespack from the Milwaukee Brewers.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Twins 9-6**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a 9-6 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Iván Herrera leading the charge at the plate. Herrera's impressive performance included two home runs and three RBIs in just three at-bats.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Blue Jays 3-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 3-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Paul Goldschmidt leading the offense. Goldschmidt hit his 9th home run of the season, a fly ball to left field that scored Cody Bellinger.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Orioles 9-3**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured a 9-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Randy Vásquez earning the win after 5.0 IP, 5 K, 2 ER, and 2 BB. Samad Taylor led the Padres' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBI.

top_news.title: **Nationals Cruise Past Mariners 8-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a decisive victory over the Seattle Mariners, winning 8-3. Colt Emerson led the Mariners' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Pirates 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 4-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Liam Hicks and Heriberto Hernández contributing key hits for the winning team. Max Meyer and Paul Skenes stood out on the mound for the Marlins, while Bryan Reynolds and Nick Gonzales led the Pirates' offense.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Orioles 5-2**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured a 5-2 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Fernando Tatis Jr. and Jackson Merrill contributing to the winning effort. Other notable performers included Rodolfo Durán, Gunnar Henderson, Jeremiah Jackson, and Blaze Alexander.

top_news.title: **Rangers CF Michael Helman Lands on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers center fielder Michael Helman has been placed on the 10-day injured list. The move was made on June 14, 2026.

top_news.title: **White Sox Acquire Nolan Jones in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox have made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring outfielder Nolan Jones from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for future considerations.
